title: BNPL Bronze: How to Activate and Use Your Installment Plan
summary: Explains how to activate and use BNPL Bronze installment plans: verify the account setting “[value not available]” is true in Installment Plans, activate it, refresh checkout, select BNPL Bronze at checkout, review and authorize the payment schedule, and keep a valid payment method on file for scheduled charges. Also includes troubleshooting steps (test checkout, toggle “[value not available]” off/on if BNPL Bronze doesn’t appear).
